 Sevilla will hope to make home advantage count again, but Osasuna’s recent results against the Andalusian side suggest the hosts should not expect an easy evening.

 Sevilla - Aiming to bounce back
 Sevilla has had a difficult run of results, with only one win in their last five matches across all competitions. In the following sections, we will take a closer look at their current form and the expected Sevilla vs. Osasuna line-ups.
 Recent form
 Sevilla head into this fixture in sixth place in La Liga, having won four, drawn two and lost three of their nine matches. Their recent run has been difficult, with defeats to Barcelona and Real Madrid among their latest results.
 Luis García Plaza’s side drew 3-3 away to Levante before losing 4-1 at Real Madrid. They have now conceded three goals in each of their last three matches, so tightening up defensively will be a priority.
 Sevilla have scored in all nine of their league games this season, but they have managed more than one goal in only one of their four home fixtures. Their most recent home meeting with Osasuna ended in a narrow 1-0 victory, offering some encouragement ahead of Monday’s match.
 The hosts will be without Marcao, Miguel Sierra and Jon Guridi through injury. Giorgi Kochorashvili is available for selection after recovering from a calf problem, while Isaac Romero returns from suspension but is expected to start on the bench.

 Osasuna - Fresh from a crucial win
 Let’s now turn our attention to Osasuna. We will analyse the team’s recent form, their latest results, and the key players for this match.
 Recent form
 Osasuna travel to Seville looking to build on their 2-0 victory over Racing Santander, which ended a five-game winless run in La Liga. Ante Budimir opened the scoring from the penalty spot before substitute Asier Osambela sealed the win late on.
 The result was a welcome boost for new coach Jagoba Arrasate , who returned to the dugout earlier this month. Osasuna had struggled before his appointment, losing four and drawing one of their previous five league matches.
 Their away form remains a major concern, however. Osasuna have conceded at least four goals in each of their last three away matches, and they will need to show considerably more defensive resilience to get a result at the Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán.
 Budimir will again lead the attack and is aiming to score in a fourth consecutive league game. The visitors will be without Jorge Herrando and Romain Del Castillo, who are sidelined with adductor problems, while Aimar Oroz is unavailable with a hamstring injury.

 Predictions for Sevilla vs. Osasuna - A much-needed home win
 Sevilla are desperate for a win to steady their campaign, and they face an Osasuna side with a dreadful away record. With the visitors conceding heavily on their travels, we could see a game that does not end in a draw and has over 2.5 goals .
 Both sides have attacking threats capable of making a difference, especially Osasuna’s in-form striker Ante Budimir. The defensive vulnerabilities on display make Over 0.5 goals in the first half an interesting option.
 Despite their own inconsistent form, Sevilla’s need for points combined with Osasuna’s travel sickness points towards a home victory. Therefore, our main prediction is for Sevilla to win the match.
